exact_statement: For every finite uniform Boolean sign and finite adaptive physical block restriction tree with no coordinate rerevealed on a path, and complete leaf subprobability references Q_l positive on the actual leaf Fourier support, the compatible lift r_h(T)=2^(-|A_h|)sum_y Q_hy(T), Q_h(U union T)=theta_h(U|T)r_h(T) yields a complete root reference satisfying CE(P_0,Q_0)=sum_h pi_h(B_h+J_h-kappa_h)+sum_l pi_l CE(P_l,Q_l). Here theta is the actual parent spectral conditional kernel and kappa_h=sum_T q_h(T)D_2(k_P(.|T)||k_Q(.|T))>=0. The total correction equals E_{S~P_0}D_2(P(L|S)||Q(L|S))=sum_l pi_l D_2(P_l||Q_l)-D_2(P_0||Q_0), and is at most terminal reference KL slack. Since J_h<=(2/ln2)I_A_h(f_h), if sum pi_h(B_h-kappa_h)<=K I_removed and CE(P_l,Q_l)<=C_leaf I(f_l), then CE(P_0,Q_0)<=max(K+2/ln2,C_leaf)I(f). No universal existence/payment of these hypotheses is asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform Boolean signs; actual Fourier-squared laws and signed child coefficients
Adaptive physical blocks determined solely by revealed history; nonempty queries; no coordinate repeated along a path
Complete terminal subprobability laws fixed before spectral sampling and positive on true support; all divergences finite
Interior references are fixed by the compatible lift; no unpriced interior reference reset
Entropy and divergence in bits; ordinary uniform physical influence; K and C_leaf finite nonnegative only for the conditional consequence
